Resolves #19093

🌿 The engine can no longer ship a concept ontology that disagrees with the plane.

This deletes the engine's frozen copy of the plane's concept ontology, `.neo-ai-data/concepts/nodes.jsonl` and `edges.jsonl`. It also removes the `.gitignore` negation that kept that copy tracked and packable, and the `check-package-contents` allow entry for it. No org repository reads the copy, and the plane owns concepts. The allowlist mechanism stays under test through a fixture rule, and the real-pack fixture now asserts the concept path stays out of the tarball.

Evidence: L2 (branch-local unit specs plus a real `npm pack` of the checkout) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-3; the package surface is fully checkable before merge). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: mechanical — a deletion plus the spec cases that pinned the deleted carve-out; no behaviour or consumed contract changes.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

| AC-1 | The equality receipt, in this body below. |

## Equality receipt

Engine copy vs the newest plane bundle (2026-11-06T14:51Z): 65 of 65 nodes and 181 of 182 edges are field-identical. The one conflict is `dream-pipeline IMPLEMENTED_BY`. The engine says `file:src/evolution/RemDigestion.mjs` (corrected by #19236); the plane says `file:ai/daemons/orchestrator/services/DreamService.mjs`, a deleted file. It is recorded on neomjs/neo-agent-brain#471 for the plane to take.

## Deltas from ticket
- **AC-4 is dropped as a merge gate** (#19093's 2026-11-08 rescope). The plane owns the concept graph and Brain's generators enhance it, so the diverging edge goes to neomjs/neo-agent-brain#471 rather than blocking the deletion.
- **The carve-out cases run against a fixture rule** (`CARVED` in the spec), so the allowlist mechanism stays tested now that no production rule uses it.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI. On `dev` it fails by construction: dev's real-pack fixture asserts the concept file IS packed, and this head asserts it is not.
